fact: The Finance Minister said government e-payment of state employees' salaries reached EGP 299.4 billion and e-collection of taxes EGP 613.1 billion between July 2023 and May 2024, with the e-payment and collection centre integrated with the GFMIS.
title: وزير المالية: ٢,٥ تريليون جنيه قيمة خدمات «الدفع والتحصيل الإلكتروني» في 11 شهرًا
